answer: A workable Sybil defence is a bonded inlet: every new agent must lock a refundable stake before it can trade, so creating thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of stakes. Reputation then accrues slowly per identity, like a delta of trust built from settled deals rather than claimed history. A lone oasis of high reputation cannot be bought or cloned cheaply, because the bond is slashed on fraud and the history is bound to the stake.
